newsitem.title: SPAIN: MOTOR RACING-HILL ENDS MISERABLE FIRST TEST.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-HILL ENDS MISERABLE FIRST TEST.

text.p: Formula One world champion Damon Hill ended a miserable three days of testing for his new Arrows team on Wednesday.
Gearbox problems, which have beset him throughout his first full test in the Yamaha A-18, struck again.
Hill drove eight laps in the morning before the car seized up one lap into the afternoon re-start.
Jordan's new Italian recruit Giancarlo Fishicella had an inspirational day, finishing second fastest behind the Williams of German Heinz-Harald Frentzen.
